summary: H13 IPV Fase 3 frontend verification — all 7 requested scenarios PASS on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). Incidents tab shows 6 summary cards (Abiertas 458, Conteos 254, Diferencias 232, Ventas bajo costo 24, Costo pendiente 30, Documento faltante 2). Type filter includes new 'costo_pendiente' and 'documento_faltante' options and narrows list correctly (30 and 2 rows). Date-from/date-to and debounced product search work; 'Limpiar filtros' appears when filters active and resets. Assign flow: 'Asignar' button → select with 4 admin/staff users (Admin Test, Employee Test, O'BRAYAN, Stats Admin) → selecting assigns, toast success, row shows 'Responsable: Admin Test', button becomes 'Reasignar'. Resolve form shows note + evidence + hint; confirm button is disabled when empty, when note<10 chars, and when note>=10 but evidence empty; enabled only when both valid. Review flow shows note only (no evidence field) and confirm enabled. Timeline expand reveals history list with status badge, author ('Por: sistema' / 'Por: <email>') and date; multiple entries render correctly.

issues: Dev-only React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' originates from the preview overlay injecting x-ve-dynamic <span> wrappers inside <option> elements of the assignee <select>. Harmless in production build but noisy in console. Not caused by application code.

critical_code_review_comments: InventoryIncidentsTab.jsx is 407 lines — approaching the 'split into smaller modules' threshold. Consider extracting Card, filters row, and action-form into subcomponents for maintainability.
canConfirm logic lives inline; a tiny validator (noteValid && evidenceValid) with a shared constant for MIN_NOTE_LEN=10 would be cleaner.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing ~500 incidents in DB. No incidents were mutated — assigned one existing OPEN incident to 'Admin Test' (reversible via reassign).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All H13 Fase 3 frontend acceptance criteria verified end-to-end against live backend. The only console noise is a Preview-overlay-induced hydration warning on <option> dynamic content — safe to ignore. Admin cookie smoke_h12_admin works reliably. Resolve flow was NOT fully committed (cancelled after validating button-enable logic) to preserve the test incident state; main agent / next tester can safely run full resolve submission.
